close_reason: Resolved 2026-05-10: changed pub(crate) mod helpers to bare mod helpers in jmap-server/src/lib.rs to match the workspace convention (every other server crate uses bare mod). Functionally identical: pub fn items inside helpers remain visible to other modules in the crate either way. cargo test --workspace clean; cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings clean. Commit d552647.
description:
crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs has:
- Line 15: `pub(crate) mod helpers;`
- Line 24: `mod parse;`
- Line 25: `mod response;`

All three are crate-internal modules whose items are selectively re-exported. The visibility annotations should be uniform — pick one and apply consistently.

Every other server crate uses `mod helpers;` (no visibility annotation, default-private). This is the only crate in the workspace that uses `pub(crate) mod`.

Recommended: align jmap-server to bare `mod helpers;` (the workspace dominant pattern).

jmap-server is the foundation server crate per workspace AGENTS.md. Cosmetic only.

Marked opinion.
title: P3: jmap-server mixes pub(crate) mod and mod for similar internals
